original_answer.example_en: Rub your hands together to lather up the soap.
original_answer.example_zh: 双手互相搓一搓，让肥皂起泡。
original_answer.usage_note: lather up是搓出泡沫，也可说work up a lather。

previous_author_answer.example_en: Rub your hands together with soap until they lather up.
previous_author_answer.example_zh: 双手抹上肥皂搓揉，直到起泡。
previous_author_answer.usage_note: lather up是搓出泡沫；说lather up with soap更自然。

revised_answer.example_en: Rub some soap between your hands until it lathers.
revised_answer.example_zh: 在双手之间搓揉一些肥皂，直到肥皂起泡。
revised_answer.usage_note: lather up指用肥皂等搓出泡沫；也可说work up a lather。例句中的it指soap。

original_answer.example_en: The restaurant has a smart-casual dress code.
original_answer.example_zh: 这家餐厅要求商务休闲着装。
original_answer.usage_note: dress code指着装规定，不是服装品牌或尺码。
